subject: QBR Ready-room: Skyline Analytics — renewal health & exec attention items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR Ready-room: Skyline Analytics — renewal health & exec attention items

Team —

We have Skyline's QBR the week of Aug 6 (proposed window). I want to pull a short ready-room so we can flag early items for exec attendance. High-level asks below — please update the sheet in the Drive link and confirm owners by EOD Friday.

Quick context: Skyline is a long-tail analytics customer but has been a growth driver for our Dedicated offering; renewal touches $420k ARR and procurement is already probing pricing/terms. Their CSM flagged an uptick in latency-sensitive workflows after they expanded seq lengths in May.

Priority checklist (please treat as actionable):
- Customer health summary (1 slide): adoption, latency trends, cost per token delta since May. Owner: @Marissa
- Renewal risk register (CSV): list breaches, mitigation plan, canary/rollout ask, escalations. Owner: @Grace
- Exec asks (one-pager): where we need CT/VP level nudges (credits, SLA exception, or product prioritization). Owner: @Lauren
- Security brief (1 slide): redlines from their procurement/security team. Owner: @Stephanie

Immediate signals to include in the register:
- Latency SLO misses (avg p95 > 350ms) on large-embed routes (May 1–Jun 30)
- A billing dispute flagged by procurement about token overages in June
- Request to enable Private deployment evaluation for EU data residency (future ask)

Attachments: I dropped a placeholder deck and the risk CSV into the Drive link.

Timing: Ready-room on Mon Jul 29 10:00 PT — 30 minutes. If you cannot attend, mark your section updated in the sheet.

Thanks —
Karthik
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR Ready-room: Skyline Analytics — renewal health & exec attention items

Karthik —

Thanks for the primer. I'll own the exec asks doc. Initial splits/owners below — will add items into the CSV by EOD Friday: 

- Exec asks: Lauren (I'll call out the two items that likely require CT-level intervention: a one-off credit and an SLA latency credit policy exception)
- Renewal risk register: Grace (will work with Marissa to add telemetry and CSM notes)
- Health slide: Marissa
- Security brief: Stephanie (looping in Legal if we need to pre-approve any data residency wording)

A couple of notes: Grace, if latency p95 breaches are sustained for >2 weeks, that should be marked "High" risk with an immediate mitigation (burst capacity + warm KV cache plan). Also — procurement asked for sample SOC2 evidence and our retention policy summary; Stephanie, can you confirm we have the latest packet?

I'll draft the exec ask page and share a 1-paragraph summary for CT to read in advance of the QBR.

-L
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Adding field notes from CSM/SAM: 

- Adoption: 3 new teams onboarded in June (marketing analytics, trading desk). Usage up ~28% MoM, but 60% of the increase is on long-seq routes where we've seen cold-start latency.
- Telemetry: attached a small export with p50/p95/p99 for the last quarter. I'm uploading the renewal-risk-register.csv to the Drive (see link).
- Billing: procurement raised a question about June overages; finance is reconciling. Noted in the risk CSV as "investigate billing line items" (owner: Grace).

Attachments: renewal-risk-register.csv (rows: issue,priority,owner,mitigation,escalation_required) ; telemetry_snapshot_Jun2028.csv

I'll build the one-slide health summary and drop into the deck by Monday morning.

-Marissa
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Skyline QBR — proposed slot & agenda items

Nikhil —

Thanks for the availability window. We'd like to propose Wed Aug 7 at 10:00 PT for Skyline's QBR (30 min). Proposed agenda:

1) Quick health snapshot (adoption, latency, usage) — Marissa (7 min)
2) Renewal/contract status and ask summary — Lauren (6 min)
3) Security & procurement open items — Stephanie (6 min)
4) Exec ask and next steps (CT or VP handoff if needed) — Karthik (8 min)

Attachments: preliminary QBR deck (Skyline_QBR_deck_v1.pdf) and renewal-risk-register.csv. If procurement wants a pre-read, we can send the security packet.

Please confirm the slot or propose an alternative. If you want a separate procurement sync, we can schedule a follow-up.

Best,
Karthik
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Verma <n.verma@skylinenet.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@skylinenet.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyline QBR — proposed slot & agenda items

Karthik —

Wed Aug 7 at 10:00 PT works for us. Thanks for the clear agenda. Two quick asks from our side before the meeting: 

1) Can you include a short slide on data residency options and timelines (we have EU teams asking about Private deployment)?
2) Procurement would appreciate a pre-read of SOC2 evidence + retention policy; I've CC'd our procurement alias.

We'll confirm the attendee list later today. Looking forward to the sync.

Regards,
Nikhil Verma
Head of Platform, Skyline Analytics
